title: 5 CD Lot Jazz: Sinatra 80th, Doc Severinsen, Fourplay, Boss Brass, Saunders
conditionDescription: Pre-owned. Discs and jewel cases show normal light wear consistent with age/storage. Please review photos for exact condition.
descriptionText:
Lot of 5 pre-owned jazz CDs. Includes:

Frank Sinatra - Sinatra 80th: Live in Concert (Capitol, 1995)
Doc Severinsen & The Tonight Show Band - Once More... With Feeling! (Amherst, 1991), with guests Tony Bennett and Wynton Marsalis
Fourplay - Journey (Bluebird/RCA Victor, 2004)
Rob McConnell & The Boss Brass - The Brass Is Back (Concord Jazz, 1991)
Carl Saunders - Eclecticism (SNL Records, 2000)

All 5 CDs, jewel cases, and pictured inserts/artwork are included. Items are pre-owned and may show normal cosmetic wear from age and storage. Please review all photos carefully for exact condition and contents.

You will receive the exact CDs pictured.
